description: Use this when asked to verify citations or quotes ("do these sources really say this?"). Pass `citations` (1-20 {url, quote}). GAIP fetches each page once (robots.txt respected); returns QUOTE_FOUND / QUOTE_NOT_FOUND_IN_FETCHED_VERSION / SOURCE_UNREACHABLE..., an excerpt and a receipt. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

name: gaip_citation_witness
title: Verify citations and quotes
